new file mode 100644
index 0000000..20e8001
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,79 @@
+---
+- name: install an older collection for upgrade
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1:0.1.0
+    -s {{ test_name }} -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections
+
+- name: upgrade within a version constraint
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1:>=0.1.0,<1.1.0
+    -s {{ test_name }} -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections --upgrade
+  register: upgraded_collection
+
+- name: repeat the upgrade
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1:>=0.1.0,<1.1.0
+    -s {{ test_name }} -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections -U
+  register: repeated_upgrade
+
+- name: read the upgraded collection
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections/ansible_collections/namespace1/name1/MANIFEST.json'
+  register: upgraded_manifest
+
+- name: check upgrade and idempotency
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "'Installing \\'namespace1.name1:1.0.9\\'' in upgraded_collection.stdout"
+    - "'Skipping \\'namespace1.name1:1.0.9\\'' in repeated_upgrade.stdout"
+    - (upgraded_manifest.content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.0.9'
+
+- name: write requirements for upgrade
+  copy:
+    dest: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-requirements.yml'
+    content: |
+      collections:
+        - name: namespace1.name1
+          version: '>=1.0.0,<2.0.0'
+
+- name: upgrade from requirements with prereleases
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install -r {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-requirements.yml
+    -s {{ test_name }} -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections --upgrade --pre
+
+- name: read the prerelease collection
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections/ansible_collections/namespace1/name1/MANIFEST.json'
+  register: prerelease_manifest
+
+- name: check prerelease upgrade
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - (prerelease_manifest.content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.1.0-beta.1'
+
+- name: install an old dependency
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install child_dep.child_collection:0.4.0
+    -s {{ test_name }} -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections
+
+- name: reject an upgrade when no-deps cannot meet its constraint
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install parent_dep.parent_collection
+    -s {{ test_name }} -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections --upgrade --no-deps
+  register: no_deps_upgrade
+  failed_when: no_deps_upgrade.rc == 0 or 'Cannot meet dependency child_dep.child_collection' not in no_deps_upgrade.stderr
+
+- name: upgrade a required dependency
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install parent_dep.parent_collection
+    -s {{ test_name }} -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections --upgrade
+
+- name: read the upgraded dependency
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections/ansible_collections/child_dep/child_collection/MANIFEST.json'
+  register: upgraded_dependency_manifest
+
+- name: check required dependency upgrade
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - (upgraded_dependency_manifest.content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '0.9.9'

         assert 'WARNING' not in msg
 
 
+def test_upgrade_resolves_latest_allowed_and_required_dependencies(monkeypatch):
+    versions = {
+        'parent.collection': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0', '3.0.0'],
+        'child.collection': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0', '3.0.0'],
+    }
+    dependencies = {
+        ('parent.collection', '1.0.0'): {'child.collection': '>=1.0.0'},
+        ('parent.collection', '2.0.0'): {'child.collection': '>=2.0.0,<3.0.0'},
+        ('parent.collection', '3.0.0'): {'child.collection': '>=3.0.0'},
+    }
+    proxy = MagicMock()
+    proxy.get_collection_versions.side_effect = lambda req: [(ver, None) for ver in versions[req.fqcn]]
+    proxy.get_collection_dependencies.side_effect = lambda candidate: dependencies.get((candidate.fqcn, candidate.ver), {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dependency_resolution, 'MultiGalaxyAPIProxy', lambda *args: proxy)
+    installed_child = Candidate('child.collection', '1.0.0', None, 'dir')
+    requirements = [Requirement('parent.collection', '>=1.0.0,<3.0.0', None, 'galaxy')]
+
+    resolved = collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [], MagicMock(), [installed_child], False, False, upgrade=True)
+    assert resolved['parent.collection'].ver == '2.0.0'
+    assert resolved['child.collection'].ver == '2.0.0'
+
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleError, match='Cannot meet dependency child.collection:>=2.0.0,<3.0.0'):
+        collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [], MagicMock(), [installed_child], True, False, upgrade=True)
+
+
+def test_upgrade_keeps_satisfied_dependency_and_requires_opt_in_for_prerelease(monkeypatch):
+    proxy = MagicMock()
+    proxy.get_collection_versions.side_effect = lambda req: (
+        [('1.0.0', None), ('2.0.0', None), ('3.0.0-beta.1', None)]
+        if req.fqcn == 'parent.collection' else [('1.0.0', None), ('2.0.0', None)]
+    )
+    proxy.get_collection_dependencies.side_effect = lambda candidate: (
+        {'child.collection': '>=1.0.0'} if candidate.fqcn == 'parent.collection' else {}
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dependency_resolution, 'MultiGalaxyAPIProxy', lambda *args: proxy)
+    installed_child = Candidate('child.collection', '1.0.0', None, 'dir')
+    requirements = [Requirement('parent.collection', '*', None, 'galaxy')]
+
+    stable = collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [], MagicMock(), [installed_child], False, False, upgrade=True)
+    assert stable['parent.collection'].ver == '2.0.0'
+    assert stable['child.collection'] == installed_child
+
+    prerelease = collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [], MagicMock(), [installed_child], False, True, upgrade=True)
+    assert prerelease['parent.collection'].ver == '3.0.0-beta.1'
+    assert prerelease['child.collection'] == installed_child
+
+
+def test_upgrade_does_not_reinstall_current_version(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
+    installed = Candidate('parent.collection', '2.0.0', None, 'dir')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(collection, 'find_existing_collections', lambda *args: [installed])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(collection, '_resolve_depenency_map', lambda *args, **kwargs: {'parent.collection': installed})
+    install_mock = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(collection, 'install', install_mock)
+
+    collection.install_collections(
+        [Requirement('parent.collection', '<3.0.0', None, 'galaxy')],
+        to_text(tmp_path), [], False, False, False, False, False, MagicMock(), upgrade=True,
+    )
+    install_mock.assert_not_called()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('flag', ['-U', '--upgrade'])
+def test_collection_install_passes_upgrade_flag(monkeypatch, tmp_path, flag):
+    install_mock = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.cli.galaxy.install_collections', install_mock)
+    cli = GalaxyCLI(args=[
+        'ansible-galaxy', 'collection', 'install', 'namespace.collection',
+        '-p', to_text(tmp_path), flag,
+    ])
+    cli.run()
+    assert install_mock.call_args[1]['upgrade'] is True
+
+

+def test_upgrade_resolves_latest_allowed_and_required_dependencies(monkeypatch):
+    versions = {
+        'parent.collection': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0', '3.0.0'],
+        'child.collection': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0', '3.0.0'],
+    }
+    dependencies = {
+        ('parent.collection', '1.0.0'): {'child.collection': '>=1.0.0'},
+        ('parent.collection', '2.0.0'): {'child.collection': '>=2.0.0,<3.0.0'},
+        ('parent.collection', '3.0.0'): {'child.collection': '>=3.0.0'},
+    }
+    proxy = MagicMock()
+    proxy.get_collection_versions.side_effect = lambda req: [(ver, None) for ver in versions[req.fqcn]]
+    proxy.get_collection_dependencies.side_effect = lambda candidate: dependencies.get((candidate.fqcn, candidate.ver), {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dependency_resolution, 'MultiGalaxyAPIProxy', lambda *args: proxy)
+    installed_child = Candidate('child.collection', '1.0.0', None, 'dir')
+    requirements = [Requirement('parent.collection', '>=1.0.0,<3.0.0', None, 'galaxy')]
+
+    resolved = collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [], MagicMock(), [installed_child], False, False, upgrade=True)
+    assert resolved['parent.collection'].ver == '2.0.0'
+    assert resolved['child.collection'].ver == '2.0.0'
+
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleError, match='Cannot meet dependency child.collection:>=2.0.0,<3.0.0'):
+        collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [], MagicMock(), [installed_child], True, False, upgrade=True)
+

+def test_upgrade_keeps_satisfied_dependency_and_requires_opt_in_for_prerelease(monkeypatch):
+    proxy = MagicMock()
+    proxy.get_collection_versions.side_effect = lambda req: (
+        [('1.0.0', None), ('2.0.0', None), ('3.0.0-beta.1', None)]
+        if req.fqcn == 'parent.collection' else [('1.0.0', None), ('2.0.0', None)]
+    )
+    proxy.get_collection_dependencies.side_effect = lambda candidate: (
+        {'child.collection': '>=1.0.0'} if candidate.fqcn == 'parent.collection' else {}
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dependency_resolution, 'MultiGalaxyAPIProxy', lambda *args: proxy)
+    installed_child = Candidate('child.collection', '1.0.0', None, 'dir')
+    requirements = [Requirement('parent.collection', '*', None, 'galaxy')]
+
+    stable = collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [], MagicMock(), [installed_child], False, False, upgrade=True)
+    assert stable['parent.collection'].ver == '2.0.0'
+    assert stable['child.collection'] == installed_child
+
+    prerelease = collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [], MagicMock(), [installed_child], False, True, upgrade=True)
